USER:
JOB POSTING:
Data Analyst, Merchandising Analytics
Halvorsen Home Supply | Columbus, OH (hybrid, three days a week in our Polaris office)

About us
Halvorsen Home Supply is a regional home improvement retailer with 64 stores across Ohio, Indiana, Kentucky and western Pennsylvania, plus a growing online business. Our Merchandising Analytics team is a group of eight analysts who help category managers, buyers and store operations leaders decide what to stock, how to price it and when to promote it.

The role
We are hiring a Data Analyst to own weekly sales, margin and inventory reporting for two of our largest departments, building materials and seasonal. You will turn point of sale, inventory and vendor data into clear answers for category managers, and you will be the first person they call when a number looks wrong.

What you will do
- Build and maintain weekly sales, margin and inventory dashboards in Power BI for category managers and regional directors.
- Write SQL against our Snowflake data warehouse to answer ad hoc questions about product, store and promotion performance.
- Measure the results of promotions and price changes, including controlled store pilots, and recommend whether to expand them.
- Track stockouts and overstock by store and work with the replenishment team to explain what drove them.
- Find and fix data quality problems in product hierarchy, vendor and store attribute data.
- Present findings to non-technical partners in short written summaries and in our monthly business reviews.

What we are looking for
- Three or more years of experience in a data analyst, reporting analyst or similar role.
- Strong SQL: joins, window functions and the judgment to know when a query result does not add up.
- Advanced Excel and hands-on experience with a BI tool (Power BI preferred, Tableau or Looker welcome).
- A bachelor's degree in statistics, economics, mathematics, computer science or a related quantitative field.
- Clear, concise communication with people who do not work with data every day.

Nice to have
- Python or R for analysis and automation.
- Experience with retail, distribution or supply chain data.
- Familiarity with Snowflake or another cloud data warehouse.

What we offer
- Salary range of $72,000 to $88,000, plus an annual bonus.
- Medical, dental and vision coverage, a 401(k) with a 5 percent match and an employee discount.
- Fifteen days of paid time off in your first year, plus paid holidays.

APPLICATION A:
Latonya Williams
Columbus, OH | (614) 555-0121 | latonya.williams@gmail.com

SUMMARY
Data analyst at an education nonprofit, two years into the analyst role after four years teaching math in grades 9 to 12 and three years coordinating program data. Works in SQL and Tableau every week, with some R to report on student outcomes for program staff, district partners and funders, and owns the data checks that keep those numbers trustworthy. Strongest at turning numbers into plain terms for audiences who do not work with data every day.

EXPERIENCE
Data Analyst | Lanternworks Education Partners, Columbus, OH | Nov 2024 to Present
• Maintain Tableau dashboards on attendance, course completion and tutoring hours for 14 partner sites serving about 3,500 students.
• Write SQL against the Postgres database behind the program management system to answer weekly questions from site directors, mostly joins and aggregates against a handful of core tables.
• Built an R script that cleans and merges quarterly attendance files from partner districts, replacing a manual process that took two days each quarter.
• Analyzed results from a tutoring pilot by comparing participating students with similar non-participants on course pass rates; wrote a four page brief the board used when deciding to expand to three more sites.
• Rebuilt the student identifier matching between the program system and district files, which raised the share of students matched across the two systems.
• Set up nightly SQL checks that flag duplicate enrollments, missing site codes and attendance dated outside a program term, and send a short exception list to site coordinators each morning.
• Meet monthly with program directors to walk through dashboard changes and collect new reporting requests.
• Prepare the data sections of eight to ten grant reports a year and answer follow-up questions from funders.

Program Data Coordinator | Lanternworks Education Partners, Columbus, OH | Aug 2021 to Oct 2024
• Entered and checked enrollment and attendance records in Salesforce for after-school programs at nine sites.
• Produced monthly Excel summaries of participation and retention for program managers.
• Trained site staff on data entry standards, which cut missing attendance records from 12 percent to under 3 percent.
• Set up a shared Excel attendance template that standardized date and ID formats across sites.
• Started learning SQL and R through online courses and took over small reporting requests from the previous analyst.

Math Teacher, Grades 9 to 12 | Ashbury Charter Network, Columbus, OH | Aug 2017 to Jun 2021
• Taught algebra, geometry and introductory statistics to about 140 students per year.
• Built gradebook and quiz score trackers in Excel and Google Sheets to spot students falling behind early in each unit.
• Led quarterly data meetings for the math department, reviewing benchmark results with six colleagues and planning reteach groups.
• Managed the department's online homework platform and reported weekly completion rates to the assistant principal.
• Explained student progress at twice yearly conferences in clear, nontechnical terms.

EDUCATION
Bachelor of Science in Statistics, The Ohio State University, 2017

SKILLS
Analysis: R (tidyverse, ggplot2, R Markdown), comparison group analysis, descriptive statistics
Data: SQL (Postgres, joins, aggregates), Salesforce reports, Excel (pivot tables, XLOOKUP), Google Sheets
Visualization: Tableau Desktop and Tableau Cloud
Communication: grant report writing, board briefs, presenting to nontechnical audiences

ADDITIONAL
• Finished the SQL track on an online learning platform, 2022
• Member of a local data analytics meetup
• Volunteer at a public library homework help desk, one evening a week
